steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We're four whole hours behind schedule...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We don't have much time left until midnight...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: The streets are deserted. We're not finding a map in a place like this either... This is a rotten turn.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: We should split up. We have our communicators. If anyone finds anything, page the rest.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Not a bad idea...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Wait, okay, that works for us, but...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: You don't have any solo experience, Sakiko. I can't let you go alone.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Now is hardly the time for that, is it?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You heard what she wrote. 'This will be my final letter.'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In the worst-case scenario, she's...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Vigna. I'll be fine.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: By Miss Whislash's account, I'm ready to operate in a squad based on my current abilities, remember?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (Takes out communicator) And I'll call at the first sign of trouble. Is that satisfactory?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Good! And don't forget us!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: ...Fine. Just be careful, yeah?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I will. Miss Iris, what's her name and address?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Her name is Ann... address, 33 Garden Street.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Acknowledged. We'll start from this crossroad. Split up and let's begin!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: *pant* *pant* How can these streets be so complicated?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Is someone selling... flowers there?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Why would someone be selling flowers at this hour...?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No, no matter. I need a lead!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Excuse me—!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Excuse me, do you know where Garden Street is?

steps.name: Florist Lady
steps.text: You're on it. Would you like a flower, Miss?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No. No, thank you... Would you happen to know which way number 33 is?

steps.name: Florist Lady
steps.text: Look up, and follow the setting sun towards the west. Last house at the end of the street, that's number 33.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Madam, it's already night...

steps.name: Florist Lady
steps.text: Oh, that's why I didn't hear any footsteps in the streets... Silly me, doddering about. Suppose it's time I went home.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Is your sight...?

steps.name: Florist Lady
steps.text: Don't you worry about me. Got somewhere to go, don't you? Better go.

steps.name: Florist Lady
steps.text: The nights are dark here. Now don't you get lost again.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Thank you... you be safe, too.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Towards the west... This is the place she meant, then.
The old door creaks as Sakiko pushes it open.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Ugh... it reeks of alcohol in here!
The ground is covered in muddy shoeprints. In the corner, there stands a ragged man.
He looks all around, then starts going through bottles tidily tucked away in the corner, picking up each one.

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: Empty...

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: Empty...

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: ...All empty!

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: Anna! Anna!!

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: Where the hell are you?!

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: *whimper* Is that it? You're abandoning me, running away, JUST LIKE SHE DID?!

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: Gh... Anna... Anna...

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: I won't drink anymore! I swear! Starting today, I'll do my best!
The man collapses to his knees in agony, then promptly screams in pain.
His palm is pierced by a shard of the bottle he broke.

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: A-Anna...! There's blood... on the floor... I'm bleeding!

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: I'm dying! Come back, Anna! I'm dying!!

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: Anna... you're back?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I'm not Anna.

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: You are... you are!

steps.name: Drunken Man
steps.text: It's me! Don't you remember me?
The man makes to crawl towards Sakiko, but lets out another scream.
Inexplicably, a wave of lamentation washes through Sakiko.
She places her hand on the battered door frame—

steps.name: Ragged Girl
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: So the story you never published... that was an account of what really happened to you?

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: I do love fairytales. Back when Mum was still around, she bought me heaps and heaps of storybooks.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: We were happy back then. Me, and Mum... and Dad.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: But the happiness left with Mum.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: I tried to write about all I'd gone through, show it to others, but nobody wants to read about oppression and despair.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: So I turned every sentence on its head. I let them become the most beautiful fairytales of all.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: ...But I stopped reading fairytales long ago.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Anna...

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: (Trembles)

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: P-Please don't call me by that name...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hurt you.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: Don't worry. You've already been much kinder to me than anyone else.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: There's Iris, actually. She's worried about you.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: You know Iris?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I do. I came with her to find you. I just gave her a call, and she's right on her way.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: Iris...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You don't want to see her?

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: I know how busy she is. Every day, she has so much to take care of...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You're a very important friend to her.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: You know... I was up on a high place today. And I kept standing up, and looking down...

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: But I had all the letters she wrote to me in my pocket. I kept every last one. And I just kept holding onto them.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: She told me to keep living. That the sweet dreams of my fairytales would come about someday.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: I don't know if I should trust myself, or trust her...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You can absolutely trust her.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: She's a real fairy, after all.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: Fairy?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You'll understand as soon as she's here. She says before you become an adult—
Sakiko looks up at the clock.
It's an antique one, hung high on the wall, and the hour and minute hands are slowly converging upon each other.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Dammit...

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Iris was saying, before you become an adult...

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: You mean, before my birthday? Iris wants to celebrate my birthday?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yes, and we're running out of time...

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: That's alright, I haven't celebrated my birthday in so long anyway.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: I'm not a child anymore. When you're grown up, you don't need celebration.
Sakiko's gaze flits around, and something catches her eye.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Ann. How about I give you your birthday's blessings?

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: ...Okay.
It is a piano.
The moon shines upon it, as though it was put there just for tonight.
Even if Iris's sweet dream doesn't make it in time, Sakiko wants to do something for Ann.

spans.text: Even if Iris's sweet dream doesn't make it in time, Sakiko wants to do

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In your last moments before you become a grown-up, an adult... allow me to play you a lullaby as a present.

steps.name: Ann
steps.text: ...Got it!
Sakiko paces up the steps. Ann sits below.
Their hearts beat. The clock ticks. The sounds gradually come into focus between them.
Thump, thump.
Tick, tock.
Sakiko's fingers weave through keys of black and white.
The notes leap with the passage of time, giving sincerest blessings to the miracle of the girl's birth.
Thank you for coming into this land.
May the future hold happiness and joy for you.
May the child live forever in your heart.
As the final note settles, a church bell rings.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Happy birthday, Ann...
Sakiko turns to look at the girl, only to find she has fallen asleep at the table, her face the picture of peaceful slumber.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Happy birthday, Ann.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Bena's in the church, waiting for Ann to wake up. Let's take a little stroll outside, shall we?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Thank goodness you made it in the end.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Mm, it was close. Thank goodness indeed.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What kind of dream did you... spin for her?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: A room of pure white, so clean it could not be real.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And in there, first things first, I inquired if she'd be willing to enter the dreamland I'd spun for her.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You are quite the noble lady, aren't you?

spans.text: quite the noble lady, aren't you?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Please do not take what Bena said at face value...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: 'You must have the child's permission before you enter their dreamland.'

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It's a necessary procedure as ordained by the Castle of Dreams.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I see—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Did you talk about anything else with her, after that?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: In her dream, I told her how truly beautiful her words were, and that I hope she can continue to write.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Whatever the style, whatever the story. It hardly has to be a fairytale, even.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yes. That's what I wanted to tell her too.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Before her eyes, I unveiled each and every character she'd penned.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Mr. Decaytooth who loves to eat fruit, Miss Dolly who walks on her hands... And they all had a tea party together.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: How wonderful. If only Ann could stay in that dream forever...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Dreams are not for wallowing in.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: No matter how sweet the dream, one has to wake up in the end.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Even if reality is callous and chaotic?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You and Bena have such powerful Originium Arts...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Sakiko, you misunderstand the power of fairytales and the Castle of Dreams. In the face of reality, what we can accomplish is so very limited.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It is but one thing. We nestle a seed deep in the depths of a child's heart.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Likely, it is what they considered the most important event, or thing, to them as children.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It usually lies quietly deep within. But at crucial moments—when people are at their weakest—it gives them strength.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: ...Am I being a little too weighty, here?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No. I saw the conviction in your eyes as you spoke.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I'm sure the dream you spun for Ann will stay with her, and give her the courage to live in the days to come.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Mm. I believe so too, though my reason is a little different.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Before I spun her dream, I found in her heart a tiny seed.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Sweet dreams from the Castle are far from the only way to plant the seeds of faith—

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It's all thanks to you, Sakiko.
Yeah, your piano was amazing!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I told you you'd be a killer musician. You need to get on stage at Rhodes Island's concerts!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Oh please, Vigna, spare me...
As Vigna and Sakiko mock-fight, Iris draws an item out of a box.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You mentioned having strange dreams, Sakiko?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Carry this necklace with you, and the nightmares should lessen.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Are you... sure I should have this?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Just take it, honestly. It's nothing valuable. A little Arts-enchanted, that's all.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hey—gimme one too!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Do you also have nightmares?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I mean... probably maybe? I don't remember!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: No. I can tell you've been a perfectly sound sleeper all your life.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Ughh—man, it's no fun dealing with you fairies! Nothing's secret from you.
As her colleagues chat, Sakiko carefully puts the necklace on.
She feels a gentle coolness at her neck, that then spreads through her entire body.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Oh, how beautiful...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Iris, Vigna, look—
Nobody is there.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Vigna?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Iris?
Sakiko looks around her.
Nobody is there.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Where... Hello?
Sakiko begins to make for the church she just left, every step more urgent than the last.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Bena!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Ann!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What...? Why am I back at Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Perplexed Operator
steps.text: Miss Sakiko?

steps.name: Perplexed Operator
steps.text: Are you alright?
Are—are you—alright?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (Turns around)—!
H-Hello?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: It's like how everything used to be... It's almost like we're dreaming.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Ugh... a dream?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Sakiko? Sakiko!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mm... hmm?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Time to get up, sleepyhead! It's a beautiful day.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: It's so cold...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: My head hurts...
Saki... ko.
Sa—ki—ko!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mmgh... where am I?
She is inside a massive castle.
Looking up at the sky through the large window, she saw twin moons floating in the night sky.
The cold has cleared up her mind. She looks around her.
(Perplexed chirping)

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: W-What kind of creatures are these?!
Oh my, did someone come to?
The crisp sound of heels striking the ground rings out from the shadows.
And thereupon a figure emerges, and slowly draws close to Sakiko.
Clack, clack.
Humph! How boring.
